title: SEBI's Madhabi Puri Buch: Protecting Your Money from Online Threats
description: SEBI Chairperson Madhabi Puri Buch recently highlighted the crucial need for stronger cybersecurity in India's financial markets. This means stock exchanges, .

faq.a: SEBI (Securities and Exchange Board of India) is the regulator for the securities market in India, responsible for protecting investors, promoting market development, and regulating market intermediaries.
Madhabi Puri Buch is the current Chairperson of SEBI, appointed in March 2022. She is the first woman to head the capital markets regulator.

MIIs are crucial entities in the financial market like stock exchanges (e.g., NSE, BSE), clearing corporations (which ensure trades are settled), and depositories (which hold shares in electronic form).

faq.q: How can I protect myself from online financial threats?
faq.a: Always use strong, unique passwords, enable two-factor authentication, be cautious of suspicious emails or messages (phishing), and only use trusted financial apps and websites.

faq.q: Does SEBI also regulate banks for cybersecurity?
faq.a: SEBI primarily regulates the securities market. The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) is the main regulator for banks and their cybersecurity. However, there is collaboration between regulators on broader financial sector cybersecurity.
